DESI survey simulations, observational systematics, and
time-domain cosmology.

## Major DESI Collaboration Papers

**Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Collaboration**,
covering the survey data releases, large-scale structure
measurements, baryon acoustic oscillations, and cosmological
constraints.
